groups.text: The group decided to go for a hand dynamo as the power source.
We will use the LCD screen for all display and provide a channel overview on the LCD to select a channel.
Go with a single curved design shape.
Use one integrated scroll-wheel push-button as the primary input and drop all other buttons, with the button providing Up, Down, and Okay functions.
Adopt a seven-point scale for evaluating the design and set the current rating to two.
Budget is tight and funds are limited, risking the ability to include all desired features.
There are no physical buttons available to meet the design requirement.
The prototype cannot draw on the lower half of the screen because the drawing area is too small.
PM will write the final report detailing all decisions made so far.
All participants will enter the questionnaire.
PM will create an issue named finance.
